stem: The Luxembourg segment of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, started November 2026 with €940 of MRR and ended it with €985. In November it gained €120 of new business, €50 of expansion and €40 of reactivation, and lost €25 to contraction. The rest of the change was churn. How much MRR did churn remove in November? Give euros with 2 decimals.
